redlist_no.citation: Artsdatabanken (2021, 24. november). Norsk rødliste for arter 2021. Utvalg https://lister.artsdatabanken.no:443/rodlisteforarter/2021?Export=true. https://lister.artsdatabanken.no/rodlisteforarter/2021
redlist_no.citation_evidence: Verbatim from the workbook's 'Siteres som' sheet.
redlist_no.license_status: pending_external_verification (not declared in workbook; see generated/taxonomy_v2/manifest.json.redlist_no.license for the full evidence trail)
notes: Norway and Svalbard are kept as separate rows and never merged.

60 rows are held unresolved by the source-row coherence check (46 NorTaxa species-aggregate 'coll.' vs strict-species workbook, 14 spelling variants or nom. dub. flags); 22 conflict groups with disagreeing categories are recorded verbatim in redlist_no_diagnostics.json.collisions.conflicts for later curation.

Runtime API: get_redlist_lookup(...) returns an explicit RedlistLookupResult (status: none / unique / multiple_same_category / conflict). The legacy get_redlist_assessment(...) returns None for conflict groups — never auto-picks.
The bridge namespace is artsnavnebase_scientific_name_id (Artsdatabanken's name registry), NOT artsdatabanken_taxon_concept_id.
Activation is ON by default (since 0.9.23); taxonomy_v2_activation: false or SPORELY_TAXONOMY_V2=0 turns it off.
Falls back to the current bundled vernacular_multilanguage.sqlite3 whenever activation or verification fails.

tax-2026.09.26-02 is the packaged release; it is built from database/taxonomy/release-recipe.json with database/taxonomy/scripts/build_release.py (two independent runs, byte-identical) and promoted by its --promote step.
